pages.title: Ada Lovelace
pages.purpose: Profile page showing Ada Lovelace's name, short bio, and two works using ProfileCard components with static local data.

components.name: ProfileCard
components.purpose: Reusable card component that renders a title, description, and optional meta text passed via props.

files.purpose: Home page assembling Ada Lovelace profile header and two ProfileCard entries for Analytical Engine and Note G using static data.
Presentational card accepting title and description props with local static data drives no external requests.

acceptance.action: Open the / route and inspect the page heading area.
acceptance.expected: The page displays the name 'Ada Lovelace' as a visible heading.

acceptance.action: Read the text below the name heading.
acceptance.expected: A short introductory biography paragraph about Ada Lovelace is visible.

acceptance.action: Inspect the cards rendered on the page.
acceptance.expected: Exactly two work cards are visible, titled 'Analytical Engine' and 'Note G', each with its description.

acceptance.action: Check the rendered page for image tags or network-driven content.
acceptance.expected: No external image or remote request is present; all content comes from static local data.
